title: Copay Card Program Years and the Card Benefit Standing — Specialty Pharmacy Program Assistance Bulletin
content:
**Program year.** Under the Specialty Pharmacy Program, a card program year runs from January 1 to December 31 of the program year named on its benefit load.

**Benefit standing before retail use.**

- When the latest shipped fill shipped within the program year of the latest benefit load on the enrollment's ledger, the benefit standing before retail use is that load less the card payments taken off it.
- When the fill shipped after that program year ended, the benefit standing before retail use is zero, because the new program year's benefit has not been loaded.
- Otherwise the benefit standing before retail use is the assistance balance shown on the enrollment. This covers an enrollment with no load on its ledger, and a fill that shipped before the load's program year began.

The benefit a copay card payment draws on is worked out under this rule. The assistance balance shown on the enrollment serves only in the last case.

## Terms used

- **Latest benefit load.** The benefit load entry with the latest entry date on the enrollment's ledger. Its amount is the program year's benefit as loaded, and its program year sets the January 1 to December 31 span.
- **Latest shipped fill.** The enrollment's shipped fill with the latest ship date. Its ship date is compared with that span.

## Ladder

| Ship date of the latest shipped fill, compared with the latest load's program year | Benefit standing before retail use |
|---|---|
| On or after January 1 and on or before December 31 of that year | the load amount less the card payments taken off it |
| After December 31 of that year | zero |
| Before January 1 of that year, or no load on the ledger | the assistance balance shown on the enrollment |

## Cases (assumed: latest load for program year 2026 of $6,000.00, with $1,250.00 of card payments taken off it; assistance balance shown of $4,900.00)

| Latest fill shipped on | Benefit standing before retail use |
|---|---|
| 2026-01-01 | $4,750.00, since January 1 is inside the program year |
| 2026-12-31 | $4,750.00, since December 31 is inside the program year |
| 2027-01-02 | $0.00, since the fill shipped after the program year ended |
| 2025-12-30 | $4,900.00, since the fill shipped before the program year began |

If the ledger shows no benefit load at all, the benefit standing is the $4,900.00 shown on the enrollment.
